what_happened: Scene: brown kettle on the counter LEFT of the gas range (same layout as s4/s17). Stage 0: on the approach (104-152) the wrist view shows the handle lying horizontally across the kettle top, along the closing axis. The hold at 125-147 lifted it only 5 mm. 160-240 the arm went over the range and hovered over the front-left grate empty-handed. It came back at 280-392 with the same flat-handle view (hold 369-386, lift 2 mm) and tried again at 536-546 with the wrist slightly rotated (lift 3 mm). From ~620 to 1000 it stayed at the kettle making short closes (764-771, 794-802, 876-877, 882-890; lift <=5 mm). Seven closes in total, and none lifted the kettle (it moved 0.3 cm). No knob contact.
causal_chain: handle presented flat, along the closing axis -> 7 closes 125-890, max lift 5 mm -> kettle never left the counter -> stage 0 never complete (stage 1 never started)
self_recovery: Re-attempts at 369, 537, 764, 794, 876 and 882, with some wrist rotation from 536. None lifted the kettle.
uncertain_about: Handle orientation is read from the wrist view; in the later attempts (620-1000) the handle looks more diagonal and I cannot see why those closes failed.
